geometry: White square-cornered quarter note and explicit rectilinear triplet numeral on a transparent 16 by 16 canvas. The note spans x=4–12 and y=1–15, with a 2-unit stem and 8 by 5 head; the numeral spans x=1–4 and y=1–6.
limitations: The tiny numeral retains the source's deliberately blocky design. Native and 8x renders were visually inspected.
